title: Get popular tracks from the Commercial Music Library
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of up to 100 popular tracks that are pre-cleared for use in organic content and ad creation from the Commercial Music Library. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/discovery/cml/trending_list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.

To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738084387220481#item-link-Get%20a%20TikTok%20account%20access%20token).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |business_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738084387220481#item-link-Get%20a%20TikTok%20account%20access%20token) to this field.| |genre|string|The specific genre to filter the results by.

Default value: `ALL`.

For enum values, see List of values for `genre`.| |country_code|string|The code of the location to filter the results by.

Default value: `US`.

See [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010) for the supported values.| |date_range|string|The timeframe in which the tracks have been popular.

Enum values:
  • `1DAY`: last one day.
  • `7DAY`: last seven days.
  • `30DAY`: last 30 days.
  • `90DAY`: last 90 days.
Default value: `7DAY`.| ``` ### List of values for `genre` ``` xtable | Value{30%} | Description{70%} | |---|---| | `ALL` | All | | `ROCK` | Rock | | `POP` | Pop | | `LATIN` | Latin | | `METAL` | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/discovery/cml/trending_list/?business_id={{business_id}}&genre=FOLK&country_code=US&date_range=7DAY' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|list|object[]|The list of the trending tracks.| ##|commercial_music_id|string|The ID of the track.

Example: `1234567890`.| ##|commercial_music_name|string|The name of the track.| ##|duration|integer|The duration of the track in seconds.

Note: For a track that is only a part (clips) of the full piece of music and not the entire piece, the duration might be recorded as 0.| ##|thumbnail_url|string|The URL of the thumbnail image associated with the track.| ##|artist|string|The name of the artist who performed the track.| ##|preview_url|string|The URL for a preview of the track.

The URL won't expire.| ##|genres|string[]|A list of genres associated with the track.| ##|rank_position|string|Current rank position of the track in the selected region (`country_code`).

Example: `100`.| ##|trending_history|object[]|The historical ranking data for the track, spanning up to the past 30 days.| ###|date|string|Date, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Example: `2024-01-01`.| ###|rank_position_daily|string|The rank position of the track in the selected region (`country_code`) on the date.

Example: `73`.

Note: If the track does not perform well compared to the last time period, the track will not be considered a popular track and the value of this field will be `NULL`.| ##| full_duration_song_clip | object | Information related to the track, including the full duration of the track. | ###| preview_url | string | The track preview URL.
The URL won't expire.

Note: This is the same as the `preview_url` parameter outside `full_duration_song_clip`. | ###| duration | integer | The track duration in seconds.

Note: This value is the same as the existing duration value. | ###| song_clip_id | string | The track ID.

Note: This value can be passed to the `music_sound_id` in [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234). | ##| trending_song_clip | object | Information related to the most popular track in the last 30 days. | ###| preview_url | string | The track preview URL.
The URL won't expire.

Note: This is the same as the `preview_url` parameter outside `trending_song_clip`. | ###| duration | integer | The track duration in seconds.

Note: This value is the same as the existing duration value. | ###| song_clip_id | string | The track ID.

Note: This value can be passed to the `music_sound_id` in [/business/video/publish/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1762228496095234). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "artist": "{{artist}}", "commercial_music_id": "{{commercial_music_id}}", "commercial_music_name": "{{commercial_music_name}}", "duration": 123, "genres": [ "Folk" ], "preview_url": "{{preview_url}}", "rank_position": "1", "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "trending_history": [ { "date": "2024-09-24", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-23", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-22", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-21", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-20", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-19", "rank_position_daily": "1" }, { "date": "2024-09-18", "rank_position_daily": "1" } ] }, ..., { "artist": "{{artist}}", "commercial_music_id": "{{commercial_music_id}}", "commercial_music_name": "{{commercial_music_name}}", "duration": 148, "genres": [ "Folk", "Indie_Folk" ], "preview_url": "{{preview_url}}", "rank_position": "3", "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "trending_history": [ { "date": "2024-09-24", "rank_position_daily": "3" }, { "date": "2024-09-23", "rank_position_daily": "2" }, { "date": "2024-09-22", "rank_position_daily": "2" }, { "date": "2024-09-21", "rank_position_daily": "2" }, { "date": "2024-09-20", "rank_position_daily": "2" }, { "date": "2024-09-19", "rank_position_daily": "3" }, { "date": "2024-09-18", "rank_position_daily": "3" } ] } ] } } (/code) ```
